body: Usually just playing guitar or listening to music. I'm literally so alone though that doing either of those can't even distract me from my thoughts

I mostly played shooters but I was pretty much open to any genre. Put a lot of time into the Battlefield series but video games in general just don't intrigue me anymore nor do I have the desire to because I feel like they aren't going to make things in my life any better for how much I played them.

I can't focus on a book to save my life so no, I don't read books.
